note: Series master — admin-owned configuration, seeded here because the Design App has no Admin UI. A room picks exactly one series (kitchen rooms.series_id); the generator, cabinet library and pricing must only offer SKUs whose code matches that series' catalog. Adding a series is a data change only — code must never enumerate series; the picker lists them in FILE ORDER (ascending price ladder). startingRatePerSqft is the series rate (₹/sqft), confirmed by the business 2026-09-29: the Quote prices each cabinet as this rate × its workbook Carcass Net Sqft (the workbook itself carries no rates). finishGroups fixes the finish group per series; finishLabel is the DESIGNER-FACING name for it (PG codes and carcass material names never appear in the UI). carcass comes with the series and is never a designer choice. handleTypes lists the handle families available in that series (the catalog's _CJ/_EH model variants); a series with one entry skips the handle step entirely. finishStyle (Modern | Classic) locks a series to that finish style.
